paper_title: 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large   Language Model Training
caption: Distribution of reference answers and test cases in the dataset. Among the entries, 38.9% have reference answers, 21.9% include test cases, and 39.2% have neither reference answers nor test cases.
model_annotation: The pie chart represents the distribution of reference answers and test cases in a dataset. The chart is divided into three slices, with "Null" colored in red and making up approximately 39.2% of the chart, "Have reference answer" colored in blue and constituting around 38.9%, and "Have test case" colored in green and accounting for about 21.9%. The percentage labels are displayed outside the chart next to their corresponding slices. A legend is provided at the top left of the chart, correlating the colors with their respective labels. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top left, with "Null" being the largest, followed by "Have reference answer", and then "Have test case".
